subject: Architecture
title: Bamboo: The Green Steel
description: A quick win: understand Bamboo: The Green Steel.

hook.text: Bamboo grows three feet per day, reaches full strength in five years, and is stronger than steel by weight.

buildup.text: Over one billion people live in bamboo structures. It's the world's most-used natural building material.

discovery.text: Engineered bamboo laminates can replace hardwood, steel, and even concrete in many structural applications.

twist.text: Untreated bamboo rots within two years. Modern treatment with borax extends its lifespan to over 50 years.

climax.text: The Green School in Bali built an entire campus from bamboo — classrooms, bridges, and a sports hall.

punchline.text: It's a grass that builds like steel and grows back in months.
